clips.title: The story
paras: In the town of Brill, a Forsaken tailor named Gretchen Dedmar struggles against the creeping cold of mortality and decay. Fearing that the encroaching mindless state will rob her of the ability to serve Lady Sylvanas, she asks for simple materials to sew herself a warm blanket.

For the Forsaken, undeath is not a static condition of eternal preservation. As Gretchen Dedmar describes, the lingering Plague of Undeath runs through her body like an icy serpent, draining the warmth from her limbs and threatening to pull her into the mindless state that afflicts so many wandering corpses in Tirisfal Glades. Her shivering hands make ordinary work nearly impossible.

Despite her failing strength, Gretchen refuses to abandon her duty to the Forsaken kingdom. When Sylvanas Windrunner first rallied the liberated dead, Gretchen contributed by sewing burial shrouds and body bags for fallen soldiers. By gathering sturdy duskbat pelts and coarse thread, travelers help keep her hands steady enough to craft a blanket and prolong her useful service to the Forsaken cause.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It's so cold, now. The Plague of Undeath crawls through my veins like an icy serpent. The Mindless State will be upon me soon. But no doomed destiny will prevent me from serving our Dark Lady. When the call arose I sewed body bags for the fallen soldiers of Sylvanas's mighty army.
Now my hands shake from the chill. If you would bring me five Duskbat Pelts and some Coarse Thread I could sew myself a blanket. Help me, friend, so that I can continue to serve the cause.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have five Duskbat Pelts and some Coarse Thread yet, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I appreciate your efforts, friend. May Sylvanas recognize your bravery one day....
